data.key: Divine Scion ~ Weapon and Armor Proficiency
data.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
data.description: A divine scion gains no additional weapon or armor proficiencies. She can select Greater Weapon Focus, Weapon Specialization, and Greater Weapon Specialization as feats once she qualifies for them normally (although she does not have to fulfill the prerequisite of having fighter levels in order to select these feats).
